---
title: "Hand the edition to the website"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
manual:
  page: 15
---

The final step adds the parent site's front matter and writes one dated post.
It does not deploy the website. Publication remains a separate repository
operation.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm the approved candidate"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
test -s intermediate.md
test -s params.yml
test -d ..
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Create the dated post"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
article=$(mktemp)
release_date=$(awk '/^date:/ {print $2; exit}' params.yml)

{
  echo "---"
  cat params.yml
  echo "---"
  sed '1,4d' intermediate.md
} > "$article"

mv "$article" "../${release_date}-newsletter.md"
```

The generated post is now in the parent Jekyll posts directory. Keep the source
files in this workspace as the place to make future corrections.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Inspect the handoff"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
release_date=$(awk '/^date:/ {print $2; exit}' params.yml)
sed -n '1,24p' "../${release_date}-newsletter.md"
git diff --check
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="The website received the intended artifact"}

```{bash}
#| eval: false
release_date=$(awk '/^date:/ {print $2; exit}' params.yml)
test -s "../${release_date}-newsletter.md"
rg -n '^title:|^date:|^author:' "../${release_date}-newsletter.md"
```

:::
